description.value:
Operator — Archon (Tier IV).

Trade — Papers, clean: Forge documents/seals good enough to pass sept or Witness scrutiny once. Standard fee 270 marks (Intrigue).

Trick — Ghost Ledger (1/scene): One small fact of record (a manifest line, a name on a list, a shipment count) has always read the way the Operator needs it to.
